hero.title: From chaos —
hero.subtitle: We turn your business's scattered processes into one intelligent management system — through AI, automation, and modern software development.

concept.title: From scattered workflows to unified control
concept.text: Every daily task lives in its own spreadsheet, its own chat, its own decision. Data is scattered, control is hard, time is wasted. We change that: we bring every process into one system — transparent, controllable, and ready to grow.

beforePoints: Isolated spreadsheets and duplicate manual files
Tasks and decisions lost across chat threads
Delayed reports compiled manually at day's end
Data silos between departments and branches
afterPoints: Single CRM/ERP source of truth across teams
Web and Telegram inquiries captured automatically
Live executive dashboards and operational oversight
1C, payments, and AI agents connected via API

standards.title: Architectural principles behind every build
standards.subtitle: We engineer maintainable, server-secured, modular digital foundations designed to grow with your company.

items.title: Modular, scalable architecture
items.desc: Start with a single START deliverable and seamlessly add ERP, CRM, and AI modules as operations expand without rebuilding.

items.title: Server-isolated security boundary
items.desc: Credentials, role permissions, and integration tokens stay strictly on the server layer — never exposed in client code.

items.title: Connected to your existing tools
items.desc: Your active 1C accounting, payment providers, warehouse tools, and Telegram channels unify into one connected flow.

items.title: Team onboarding & ongoing support
items.desc: At launch, we train your staff, deliver clear operational documentation, and stay on board for continuous technical support.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers on project scoping, legacy software integration, and post-launch technical care.

items.q: How are project scope, timeline, and budget determined?
items.a: After the free diagnostic and technical discussion, we align on exact module scope, delivery schedule, and commercial structure tailored to your business.

items.q: We already use 1C, spreadsheets, or a Telegram bot — do we have to replace everything?
items.a: No. We connect your existing accounting tools, payment gateways, and messaging channels via API into the unified system.

items.q: Can we start with one focused deliverable and scale later?
items.a: Yes. You can begin with a single solution under START and progressively expand into BUSINESS and AI BUSINESS modules.

items.q: Are AI agents tailored to our specific business rules and catalog?
items.a: Yes, AI workflows are configured around your knowledge base, service policies, internal documents, and CRM data.

items.q: Do you provide team training and support after launch?
items.a: Yes — stage 5 covers full launch, staff training, and continuous technical support and system evolution.
